newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan army kill 450 attacking Tamil rebels.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan army kill 450 attacking Tamil rebels.

text.p: Sri Lankan forces killed more than 450 Tamil Tiger rebels during the Tigers' counter-attacks on army advances towards their northern stronghold of Kilinochchi on Thursday, a military spokesman said on Friday.
He confirmed that 75 government soldiers, including five officers, were killed in the battles.

The spokesman said more than 1,000 members of the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) had launched two simultaneous counter-attacks from the west and the south of an army column advancing on Kilinochchi early Thursday, but were repulsed by troops using artillery and mortars.

"Ground troops confirmed over 450 terrorists were killed at both locations of the counter-attacks and over 300 wounded," he said, and added that "75 army personnel including five officers were killed. Ten officers and 146 soldiers were wounded".
The spokesman added some rebels managed to penetrate the western defences using suicide bombers who detonated their explosives near the troops.

Thursday's attacks were the first reported major assaults by the rebels since government troops launched a fresh offensive against their Kilinochchi stronghold last Sunday after a lull in the conflict of more than a month.
